name: 69357 · Mitchell, NE
findings: ZIP 69357 (Mitchell) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 69357 (Mitchell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
